responsibility: Provides the main target macro configuration for the Moxie port. This header defines the architecture’s data layout, endianness-dependent storage model, register file and register classes, calling-convention macros, stack/frame and elimination rules, addressing and alignment constraints, trampoline and exception-return conventions, assembler/linker default specs, and builtin preprocessor defines, supplying the static target description that the generic GCC backend and moxie.cc hooks rely on.
same_name_distinction: Defines the compile-time target macros, register numbers/classes, ABI constants, data layout, and assembler/linker specs that the rest of the Moxie port is built on; unlike moxie.cc it does not implement hooks, unlike moxie.md it does not describe RTL insn patterns, and unlike moxie.opt it does not declare command-line options.
